public/editor/styles.js.why: The editor's runtime-injected stylesheet. Its 26 accent literals and its dead --danger fallbacks were resolved in the polish pass; what remains is tints, one absolute white, one dark-on-fill #1A1A1A, off-scale radii, and animation durations. Alpha tints of colours that already have tokens (accent 232,122,90; success 107,198,126; working 122,162,232; attention 232,168,76). Each is a token re-typed as raw channels, so editing the token no longer moves them. Waiting on a decision about how a tint of a token is written: color-mix() and relative colour syntax both work in Electron and both change the computed value, so it is a visual change rather than a substitution. The danger tints were converted in the polish pass and are gone from this file.

Deliberate, and noted as such in the CSS. Also one shadow black and one attention tint. public/styles/components/floating-toolba.why: Shadow blacks. There is no elevation scale, so every surface picked its own alpha. Waiting on a shadow scale in tokens.css. This file alone uses four different blacks across its light and dark shadow pairs, which is the clearest argument for the scale. Plus one absolute white. Absolute white or black, chosen for contrast against a coloured fill rather than as a theme colour. Deliberate: a token here would make it follow the theme, which is the opposite of what it is for.

public/styles/views/settings.css.why: Two shadow blacks. There is no elevation scale, so every surface picked its own alpha. Waiting on a shadow scale in tokens.css. The remaining radius is deliberately off the scale: it is the outer half of a concentric pair, with four pixels of padding around an inner at --radius-md, so inner equals outer minus padding and the curves agree. Concentricity beats scale membership, and it is recorded beside the rule and in tokens.css.

Deliberate: a token here would make it follow the theme, which is the opposite of what it is for. Waiting on the JS-set style cleanup, tracked separately.
